25.title: Backstreet Rookie

She has the boys lined up but only  convenience store owner Choi Dae Hyun holds her attention. Three years ago, he became imprinted upon her as an 'unforgettable person' after a cigarette errand. Flash forward to the present; Jung Saet Byul  applies for a part-time position at Choi Dae Hyun's  convenience store, which he also manages. There their love story begins as they heal the wounds of the heart, gain love, and become adults dreaming of the future.

26.description: Kim Shin was once an unbeatable general in Goryeo's military who died a tragic death. He now possesses immortality but is tired of living while everyone else around him dies. For 900 years, Kim Shin has searched for his bride, a mortal who can pull out the sword and end his life. One day, he encounters Ji Eun Tak, a positive, upbeat high school student who can see the dead and has gone through tragic events, yet still stays strong. She claims to be the Goblin's bride who can end his immortal life, but what appears to be an easy task, only gets complicated, as the two fall in love.

Ha Baek starts to develop feelings for So Ah, but he has competition for her heart

Willing to take on any case, no matter how hard, Do Won has made a name for himself as a man who gets the job done. But when the woman he loves becomes the latest victim of a serial killer, his world completely changes. Literally.

The story of a community health worker at a psychiatric ward who lives on 1.8 million won (approximately $1,520) a month and a storybook writer suffering from an antisocial personality disorder. A man who denies love and a woman who doesn’t know love defy fate and fall in love, finding their souls and identities in the process.
Moon Kang Tae is a community health worker at a psychiatric ward who was blessed with everything including a great body, smarts, ability to sympathize with others, patience, ability to react quickly, stamina, and more. Meanwhile, Go Moon Young is a popular writer of children’s literature, but she is extremely selfish, arrogant, and rude.

However during the interview, she finds out that the CEO is the person who exposed that her boyfriend is cheating on her in public, Fang Zhi You. Though she doesn't know why, Xu Yi Ren eventually gets the job, but gets handed a weird task - to lie for her boss. But Fang Zhi You's tendency to expose her lies in public always lands her in sticky situations.

While his handsome looks captured many women’s hearts, he only shows interest in Hyun Joo. Park Do Gyum is a webtoon artist who’s been friends with Hyun Joo  since they were young. Who will be the one to win her over?

To gain experience for the role, Oh Yoon Seo is required to work as a lawyer's secretary for a few months. Meanwhile, Kwon Jung Rok is an attorney for a law firm. He is arrogant and cold-hearted. She soon befriends several of the princes and meets the ostracized 4th Prince, Wang So. Although she knows she should not get involved in palace intrigues over the succession to the throne, she inadvertently becomes a pawn in the struggle, as several of the Princes fall in love with her.

Soon Wei WuXian reunites with Lan WangJi, and the pair starts working together to solve the mysteries of the present and unravel the truth behind the events of the past.

Unfortunately, secrets have a way of coming out and as a hard-hitting homicide detective, it’s Cha Ji Won’s job to uncover as many secrets as she can, in her never-ending quest for the truth. But when Ji Won takes on a particularly cruel case, she starts down a dark path that could crumble the very foundations of her happy life. Determined to bring this evil psychopath to justice she dives ever deeper into this case, only to find that the criminal she’s been chasing may have been standing next to her all along.

Joon Woo and Yoo Bin struggle to survive in an isolated apartment complex from those infected with the virus.

His ad: “Will face off with your ghosts. 298.title: Arsenal Military Academy
298.description:
In the early years of the 20th century, Chinese military forces find themselves locked in a drawn-out, bloody conflict as they fight back again the Imperial Japanese army.

The government drafts young male conscripts to defend the besieged northeast of the country – but a woman named Xie Xiang also wants in on the action. She decides to cut her hair short and assume her brother’s identity in a bid to join the Chinese army. Xie Xiang quickly proves herself more than capable in soldiery, and soon wins herself a place in an elite military academy in Shanghai.

At the academy, she befriends a number of young male recruits, including quarrelsome rich kid Gu Yan Zheng and the gentle and introverted Shen Jun San. As the recruits begin to hone their skills, they grow in confidence – and decide to take measures of their own in an attempt to foil the invading forces.

But their struggle becomes more complicated when both Gu Yan Zheng and Shen Jun San begin to develop feelings for Xie Xiang. Will the comrades-in-arms survive the bitter ravages of military conflict? Will love derail Xie Xiang’s quest for justice? And will all really prove fair in love and war?

13000.description:
Navier is the Empress of the Eastern Empire. She is praised for her intelligence and innate elegance. Her life as empress is peaceful alongside her husband, Emperor Sovieshu. She does not love Sovieshu romantically but regards him as both a friend and family member. Having spent much of their childhood together, they share the same goal of creating a great empire. However, her relationship with her husband changes after he brings a runaway slave, Rashta, to the palace and makes her his mistress. This breaks the promise he made to Navier never to take a concubine.

Meanwhile, Prince Heinrey is the heir apparent to the throne of the Western Kingdom. His clan harbors a secret: they can transform into birds. After transforming into a bird, he travels to the Eastern Empire's palace as a spy. There, he meets Empress Navier and falls in love with her.

Empress Navier of the Eastern Empire receives a divorce notice from her husband, Emperor Sovieshu, who has fallen in love with Rashta. Rather than accepting the divorce, Navier asks for permission to remarry Prince Heinrey of the Western Kingdom.
13000.title: The Remarried Empress

13355.description:
After being blamed since birth for destroying her family, aspiring animation writer Na Ji Ni grows up carrying wounds she can never fully speak about. Despite the harsh judgment surrounding her, Ji Ni refuses to give up on her dream of creating a Korean animation that can touch people around the world. Beneath her elegant appearance and natural talent lies a woman fighting to reclaim her own life and identity.

Standing opposite her is her mother, Na Se Ri, a former star cellist of the national orchestra who once ruled Korea’s classical music scene. Proud, ambitious, and seemingly untouchable, Se Ri has spent her life protecting the flawless image she built for herself while hiding deep fears and painful secrets behind her confidence.

As the strained mother and daughter are forced to confront the scars of their past, they cross paths with No Yeong Ju, a cheerful singing instructor who once dreamed of becoming a musical actress. Having endured countless hardships with unwavering optimism, Yeong Ju slowly begins searching for happiness for herself instead of simply surviving for others.

Bound by hidden pain, broken family ties, and the desire to start over, the three women struggle against prejudice, fate, and the lives they were forced into, while discovering what family truly means.
13355.title: Family Register (2026)

13498.description:
After a painful breakup, Jan, the owner of a cozy bar, shuts her heart off from love and focuses solely on surviving in the shadows of her past. Everything changes when Key, a bold young singer, steps into her world after a one-night encounter openly declaring she wants to be Jan's sugar baby.

What begins as a purely physical arrangement morphs into something deeper as Key's warmth begins to melt Jan's icy walls. Just as their feelings become undeniable, Jan's ex unexpectedly returns, testing the fragile bond forming between them.
13498.title: Moonshadow (2026)

13581.description:
After being falsely accused of murder, Ko Eun Seol loses everything and has her life stolen from her. Determined to clear her name, reclaim her future, and take revenge on those responsible, she embarks on a relentless quest to expose the truth behind the false accusation that ruined her life.

Standing in her way is Cho Mi Ran. She comes across as warm and devoted, but that's just the surface. Underneath, she's spent years quietly taking what isn't hers, willing to steal someone else's happiness and future if it gets her closer to what she wants. She's built her entire life on lies, and she's not going to let Eun Seol tear it down.

As Eun Seol digs deeper, she crosses paths again with Cha Seok Jin, her first love, and a decade-old history neither of them has fully left behind. Old wounds resurface, long-hidden secrets begin to unravel, and she finds herself in conflict with Kang Hae Ra, sole heiress of the powerful Cheongma Group. Caught in a web of betrayal and hidden motives, Eun Seol must fight to reclaim her future and bring the truth into the light.
13581.title: A Trap Called Desire (2026)
